en.title: Frozen Fingertips and the Map Awaiting the Thaw
en.premise: Deep beneath the heavy snow, a voice echoes, unheard by any. A lonely girl living on the outskirts of a village discovers a fragment of a frozen 'Ice Castle'—a key that leads to a secret map capable of restoring the lost seasons. But as she unravels the map's mysteries, the 'Forgotten Ones' lurking within the frost begin to creep closer, craving the girl's warmth.

zh.title: 冻结的指尖与等待融雪的地图
zh.premise: 此刻，在深雪之底，回荡着无人知晓的低语。住在村边的一位孤独少女，偶然发现了一块被冰封的“冰之城”碎片。那是开启“秘密地图”的钥匙，而这张地图能唤回早已失落的季节。然而，随着地图被逐渐解读，潜伏在雪中的“被遗忘者”们，正渴求着少女的体温，悄然逼近。
